nodes.name: IntainMARKETS
nodes.short: IntainMARKETS is a digital asset-backed finance platform that brings issuers and investors, onto a common infrastructure for whole loan sales, credit facilities, and securitizations. It helps newer and smaller issuers access the full capital markets ecosystem

nodes.name: Intraday Repo Hub
nodes.orch: Intraday repo trades across various cash and collateral ledgers and trading platforms
nodes.short: Cutting-edge interconnectivity software solution that orchestrates distributed intraday repo transactions between trading platforms, digital cash and digital collateral platforms.
nodes.metric: Reached up to $1 billion in a day

nodes.name: Collateral Mobility Manager
nodes.orch: Margin calls using tokenized assets issued across multiple ledgers and smart contracts.
nodes.short: Advanced solution for treasury and collateral desks, enabling margin management using tokenized assets across multiple blockchains.

nodes.name: LayerZero Cross-chain Asset Platform
nodes.orch: Issuer-native orchestration of multi-chain deployments, minting/burning, supply synchronization, cross-chain compliance gating, investor onboarding, and distribution flows.
nodes.short: A comprehensive platform for asset issuers to deploy, manage, and operate native multi-chain assets using LayerZero, with full administrative control, compliance tooling, and programmatic cross-chain distribution across 160+ blockchains.
nodes.metric: Assets Under Management (AUM), Multi-Chain Distribution Reach, Cross-Chain Supply Flows, Investor Access Metrics.

nodes.name: CSD Distribution Platform
nodes.orch: Conversion of equities between classic and digital, and across ledgers, 24/7 pre-trading, trading and digital post trading of equities, collateral applications, corporate actions.
nodes.short: Turn digital platform integrations from a costly and sequential process into a massively scalable parallel rollout. A scalable solution for CSDs to connect multi-chain digital asset platforms to a unified FinP2P access hub, enabling all clients to access the C
nodes.metric: Used in the DTCC Collateral Mobility Experiment

nodes.name: Kaiko Data Services
nodes.orch: Connectivity to data sources, distribution of data, data driven calculations.
nodes.short: Kaiko Data Services is the trusted, compliant and independent market data and information data module for digital assets.
nodes.metric: We serve 200+ enterprise clients worldwide, from financial institutions to crypto-native enterprises.

nodes.name: Nomyx Tokenization Engine
nodes.orch: End to End Fund Operations on-chain
nodes.short:
Tokenize real-world assets in minutes

Nomyx is the complete tokenization platform for asset managers, fund administrators, and financial institutions. Deploy compliant digital securities in under 2 weeks; no blockchain experience required.

Key Features:
No-c

nodes.name: Asset Distribution & Access Hub
nodes.orch: A wide variety of investing, trading and collateral flows.
nodes.short: A distributed Hub enabling a true peer-to-peer multi-sided market where asset issuers can distribute to all regulated distribution venues and distributors can access all assets, data, and trading options across all chains.
partners: This Hub is a core infrastructure used by all business SuperApps.

nodes.name: BlueShift Borrowing & Lending
nodes.orch: Borrowing and lending workflows, including loan origination, collateralization, margin calls, collateral transfers, stress testing, and close-outs.
nodes.short: Enterprise-grade borrowing and lending solution enabling institutions to manage secured financing across crypto assets and stablecoins, with real-time collateralization, margining, and reporting.

nodes.name: BlueShift Portfolio Manager
nodes.orch: Portfolio management workflows including trade execution, portfolio monitoring, margin and collateral management, and stress testing across crypto assets, tokenized RWAs, and traditional markets.
nodes.short: Enterprise-grade portfolio management solution enabling institutions to manage execution, portfolio monitoring, risk, and reporting across crypto assets, tokenized RWAs, and traditional markets.

nodes.name: BlueShift Staking
nodes.orch: Non-custodial staking and unstaking workflows across multiple blockchain protocols, including delegation, reward monitoring, and reporting.
nodes.short: Enterprise-grade non-custodial staking solution with unified workflows, real-time reward monitoring, fee calculation, and reporting across 20+ blockchain protocols.

nodes.name: Collateral Mobility for Intraday Repo
nodes.orch: Delivered by Ownera's FinP2P software.
nodes.short: Securities settlement platform that can exchange ownership of collateral at precise moments in time. This enables the creation of an intraday repo market through interoperating with payment legs via the Ownera FinP2P router.

nodes.name: Confidential Collateral Pool
nodes.orch: Collateral poisition and risk across lenders, borrowers and price feeds
nodes.short: Private Collateral Pool enables multiple banks or large financial institutions to lend money to each other quickly and securely, using valuable assets as a safety net (collateral), without anyone outside of the specific transaction knowing exactly what assets

nodes.name: Connector to Digital Custody Tech Providers
nodes.orch: Unified ID per user controlled via a cryptographic key, approval flows for any transaction on the network, native support for various ledgers
nodes.short: For Digital Asset Custody Technology Providers - this app allows your technology solution to provide services to all SuperApps across the FinP2P ecosystem.

nodes.name: Cross-Chain Asset Converter
nodes.orch: Safely moving assets between chains, without an intermediary network such as Oracles or Bridges. Embedding the conversion flow in more complex processes such as collateral application flows.
nodes.short: Allows an institution to transfer assets between blockchains, and between blockchains and legacy ledgers, without bridges or oracles.
nodes.metric: All EVM networks, Canton, Corda, Besu, Open API to add other L1/L2s.

nodes.name: Custodian Service
nodes.orch: All transactions type supported by any of the applications, with a unified API interface
nodes.short: Enabling a custodian to serve the FinP2P ecosystem with Digital Assets custody and management services. Works in conjunction with legacy custody platforms and networks and one or more "Digital Custody Connector" Apps.
nodes.metric: Custody as a Service to the ecosystem

nodes.name: Digital Asset Marketplace
nodes.orch: Asset origination, distribution to investors, primary and secondary market execution and atomic asset transfers using DvP
nodes.short: otcDigital offers a digital assets marketplace for the capital markets with a privacy-focused, full life-cycle Web3 RWA platform connecting all market participants.

nodes.name: Exberry Matching Engine
nodes.orch: Order matching, price discovery, and real-time market data distribution across any asset class — connecting brokers, market makers, and institutional participants to trading venues through continuous trading and auction mechanisms, with seamless integration into downstream clearing, settlement, and post-trade workflows.
nodes.short: Cloud-native, asset-agnostic matching engine delivering ultra-low latency order matching, price discovery, and market data as a service for regulated and digital exchanges across any environment.
nodes.metric: Sub-20μs latency | 1M+ messages/sec | Powering exchanges across commodities, derivatives, carbon, precious metals and digital assets

nodes.name: FinP2P Router License
nodes.orch: Unlocks the ability to run any SuperApp on your FinP2P Router.
nodes.short: The core license required to activate your FinP2P Router, enabling use of any SuperApp on top of it.

nodes.name: FIX Connector
nodes.orch: Flows that involve both FIX pre-trade and trade flows, and FinP2P based order execution and settlement, including support for intraday Repo initiation and monitoring
nodes.short: Enable trading and settlement flows through FIX interface connectivity

nodes.name: Institutional Real Estate Market
nodes.orch: Participation in primary issuance, secondary OTC trading, collateral applications
nodes.short: Access to high quality institutional-grade portfolio of residential real estate assets

nodes.name: Investor SuperApp
nodes.orch: Access and trading of any type of asset against any type of asset - including Crypto, Stablecoins, Fiat, tokenized private and public market equities, funds, derivatives...
nodes.short: A multi–asset-class investment interface for investor-facing platforms, supporting any digital assets from any blockchain as well as legacy payment and assets.

nodes.name: ISO 20022 Compatibility Connector
nodes.orch: ISO 20022 messaging for payments, asset transfers, and settlements, combined with FinP2P flows for pre-trade, trade, and digital asset processes including issuance, transfer, and cross-chain settlements (DVP, DVD, PVP).
nodes.short: Enable FinP2P flows to connect with platforms using ISO 20022, the global financial messaging standard adopted by SWIFT.
nodes.metric: Support for multiple flows including collateral applications

nodes.name: LayerZero Cross-chain Connector
nodes.orch: Cross-chain smart contract invocation, asset movement, and messaging across 154+ blockchains via LayerZero’s ultra-light node protocol. Supports multi-chain settlement, token actions, and interoperability for all SuperApps.
nodes.short: A developer-focused utility that enables applications to send messages, transfer value, and synchronize data across chains using LayerZero’s secure cross-chain infrastructure.
nodes.metric: Network Coverage (157+ blockchains), Transaction Throughput, Cross-Chain Message Volume.

nodes.name: Ledgible
nodes.orch: Ledgible orchestrates digital asset data from on-chain and off-chain sources into a unified post-trade workflow — ingestion → normalization → accounting export → tax reporting.
nodes.short: Enterprise-grade digital asset post-trade, accounting, tax, and reconciliation platform that makes digital asset data clear, compliant, and ready for enterprise workflows.

nodes.name: Multi-chain Management for Token Issuers
nodes.orch: Orchestration of issuance on multiple chains, as well as issuer-native movement of the asset between supported chains.
nodes.short: A technology service that enables token issuers to manage and convert their tokens natively on multiple chains, and manage cross chain investor onboarding and white listing - without the use of external bridges or oracle network.
nodes.metric: All EVM networks, Canton, Corda, Besu, Open API to add other L1/L2s.

nodes.name: Munivestor’s Digital Bond Marketplace
nodes.orch: Munivestor facilitates a primary and secondary online marketplace for tokenized municipal bonds. Issuers and investors are allowed to connect directly.
nodes.short: Munivestor is a financial technology company on a mission to democratize and expand the $4 trillion municipal securities market. We enable cities to raise capital directly from investors globally. Our regulated online marketplace empowers cities to create, mar
nodes.metric: Total amount of new digital muni bonds issued, total mount of secondary market trades, AUM of registered investors

nodes.name: OMS and Trading for Tokenized Equities
nodes.orch: The app orchestrates the full trading lifecycle for CSD-issued tokenized equities - from pre-trade to instant post-trade settlement - connecting market participants to 24/7, cross-venue liquidity through the same high-speed infrastructure used for classic equities.
nodes.short: A fully integrated OMS and trading platform that unites pre-trade, trade, and post-trade processes—combining the speed and robustness of today’s markets with the advantages of blockchain: 24/7 access, instant settlement, stablecoin payments, portable collatera
partners: A market leading OMS and Trading Platforms provider
nodes.metric: Connectivity to legacy and digital market liquidity

nodes.name: Particula Risk Ratings
nodes.orch: Data aggregation, real‑time FinP2P rating updates
nodes.short: Particula delivers institutional-grade risk ratings for tokenized assets on the FinP2P network. Access real-time, multi-dimensional risk scores for tokenized fixed income and equity instruments  - directly within your existing workflows.

nodes.name: Payment Provider Service
nodes.orch: Management and balance of cash accounts, transfers, payments, including DvP, PvP, Repo and more
nodes.short: Comprehensive payment and cash solution for the FinP2P applications ecosystem

nodes.name: Prove Know Your Payee
nodes.short: Prove’s Know Your Payee is an identity verification solution that confirms the identity of a payment recipient before funds are sent, helping organizations prevent fraud, reduce misdirected payments, and improve trust.

nodes.name: Prove Pre-Fill for Business
nodes.short: Prove Pre-Fill® for Business streamlines B2B onboarding by instantly linking an applicant to a verified business and pre-populating key data in real time. Powered by the Prove Identity Network®, it reduces manual entry, accelerates decisioning, and improves co

nodes.name: ProveX
nodes.short: ProveX℠ is a digital trust exchange that enables instant access to verified data and credentials, unlocking seamless, secure experiences across the customer journey.

nodes.name: Universal Blockchain Connector
nodes.orch: All types of transactions from all other Super-Apps into any ledger, and between ledgers.
nodes.short: A universal FinP2P adapter to various blockchains and tokenization-specific smart contract within them. Giving financial application developers a cross-chain, cross-smart contract, unified API to settle all transaction types including issuance, trading and col
partners: Various L1s/L2s and tokenization-specific smart contract protocols
nodes.metric: Up to $1 billion in trading per day

nodes.name: Universal Stablecoin Connector
nodes.orch: Trades that utilise any stablecoin, on any blockchain
nodes.short: Direct single-point connectivity to any stablecoin, to be utilised by any other SuperApp

nodes.name: Social and Market Data SuperApp
nodes.orch: Data provider adapter: pull and subscribe, ingest of socialSentiment and assetHeader items, re-share across Routers.
nodes.short: LunarCrush social and market intelligence for 4,400+ stocks, ETFs and tokenized assets, delivered to every Router as a data utility.
